dialogues.speaker: Mozhgan
dialogues.text: Sumeru Rose, Mint, Nilotpala Lotus, and the like.

dialogues.speaker: Mozhgan
dialogues.text: Don't underestimate those small plants. You'll benefit greatly if you know how to use them.

dialogues.speaker: Mozhgan
dialogues.text: For example, your face will glow if you mash Sumeru Rose in water, and apply the mixture onto your face!

dialogues.speaker: Mozhgan
dialogues.text: So listen to me and always keep Sumeru roses in the house.
